findings.title: Derived Gate summaries and graph can reverse-influence the authoritative target Gate
findings.affected_control: Non-authoritative overall/calculated/summary/graph outputs must not affect the five-Gate calculation
findings.exact_failure_condition: Start from the clean production fixture in which Bootstrap Candidate Review is GO while Human Commit is NO-GO, both steady-state Gates are DISABLED, and Migration 320 is NO-GO. Without changing any authoritative Candidate input, change review-findings.yaml overall_gate or calculated_gate, the final-summary Gate text, or an existing task-graph.json so it disagrees with the recomputed aggregate or traceability. validateTask appends a GATE or GRAPH structural error at lines 505-517, then line 520 replaces the already-computed Gate map with one containing Structural validation failed. Candidate becomes NO-GO and a targeted Candidate invocation exits 1 rather than retaining its authoritative result.
